final_disposition: Do not freeze D1 prompts until G1/G2 acceptance content is completed; no further audit calls in this task

items.rationale: Add discriminating commitments/examples. A qualified explicit conclusion is not list-only; no lexical first-sentence gate.
Q0 compares original data to a labeled proposal. Failure is a model failure to measure, not permission to certify truth; generated hashes or repeated extraction do not prove semantic independence.
Bind definition_delivery when definition frame has an existing candidate, independent of scope acceptance; require content evidence, not a predetermined anti-carrier answer.
Clarify requests/questions/seconds and exact profile fields. Exhausted branch returns new raw evidence to host with zero new Jev.
finding-disposition already gives precedence and includes active_acceptance v0.2. Preserve old packets; make current reader entry explicit.
No adoption follows any small-sample count. Future paired table must separate harm and missing judgments; design-audit budget not benchmark budget.
Visible object/control relation improves testability. Presence of injection does not prove essence; a removal test establishes at most necessity, not sufficient explanation.
Need joint/conditional/unresolved examples. Multiple supported factors are legal. Do not recurse to Q0/Q1 or require a statistically independent final host.
Finite paired counts can be reported descriptively with all harms and costs; no general superiority or adoption is implied.
Literal reference verification cannot prove semantic mapping; do not mandate keyword gates for implicit constraints.
A request is one provider call/batch; a question is an instance. No semantic conflict between 24 questions/request and seven requests/episode.
Need explicit mixed-case examples; a conditional conclusion excludes list-only by definition, so do not count an apparent overlap as a measured model failure.
